title.zh: Ingradients · 比较柔和网格渐变

description.zh: 看Soft Rainbow大图与Download入口，未下载。 Ingradients是Gilbert Pellegrom制作的手选网格渐变素材站，可先比较预览，再查看单套下载与购买入口。免费Standard仅限个人非商业，Pro另有商用许可及数量和转交限制，模板、开源及Extended边界须依原许可核对。
description.en: Ingradients by Gilbert Pellegrom offers hand-picked mesh gradient bundles, collection previews and download or purchase controls. Free Standard assets are limited to personal, non-commercial use. Purchased Pro assets permit commercial projects subject to asset-count, client-transfer and copyright-notice conditions. Extended requirements and exclusions follow the original license; downloads and purchases were not tested.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Ingradients (https://ingradients.net/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Soft Rainbow大图与Download入口，未下载。

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页柔和渐变与设计用途说明，下滚可见Soft Rainbow和Purple Haze两套预览，后者下缘裁切，未据此推断全库数量。详情显示青粉紫大图与Download入口，本次未下载或购买。免费Standard限个人非商业，已购Pro有每项目三十项上限；客户、模板、Notice和Extended边界须按完整许可另核。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
